name: 4imprint Group plc
summary: 4imprint Group plc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a direct marketer of promotional products in North America, the United Kingdom, and Ireland. The company markets apparel, bags, drinkware, writing, stationery, outdoors and leisure, auto, home, tools, wellness and safety technology, trade show and signage, and awards and office products under the Crossland, Refresh, Taskright, and mainsail brands. It serves customers in the commercial, governmental, educational, charitable, religious, and other markets.
